proposals.evidence_class: retail bytes (relocation target read out of the renamed target obj)
evidence: Retail's body at 0x824c97d8 (section /22 of build/45410914/obj/EventTrigger.obj, size 116 = the report row size) carries exactly 3 relocations: __savegprlr_28 at +0x4, __restgprlr_28 at +0x70, and at +0x58 a call to ?insert@?$list@VEventCall@EventAnim@@V?$StlNodeAlloc@VEventCall@EventAnim@@@stlpmtx_std@@@stlpmtx_std@@QAA?AU?$_List_iterator@...@Z -- the EventAnim instantiation of list::insert.

A list<ProxyCall@EventTrigger> range-ctor cannot call list<EventCall@EventAnim>::insert. Our EventTrigger.obj's ProxyCall ctor calls ?insert@?$list@UProxyCall@EventTrigger@@...; our EventAnim.obj's EventCall ctor calls the EventAnim insert, matching retail.
This is the MPNGAP-1 adjudication method (does the named callee's signature match the call site?), which previously proved Handle@GemPlayer's map row wrong while our source was right.
proposals.not_an_icf_fold: The two instantiations are byte-identical in code (164 B section incl. EH funclet on both sides) but their relocation TARGETS differ (per-T _List_base dtor, per-T list::insert, per-T __ehfuncinfo$). MSVC folds only COMDATs identical INCLUDING relocations, so these would NOT fold -- this is the documented _List_base<T>::clear shape (42 addresses, reloc-identical surplus 0). So the charge is a wrong map NAME, not a fold alias.
proposals.predicted_effect: Row 0x824c97d8 currently reads fuzzy 99.82758 in default/EventTrigger (all 3 relocations but one agree). After the rename it should pair against EventAnim.obj's definition with all relocations agreeing => fuzzy 100 => +116 B. REQUIRES the companion splits re-home below, applied in the same change.

proposals.ordering_hazard: Do NOT apply the splits move without the rename, and do NOT apply the rename without the splits move. Either alone moves the row from 99.83 to 0 (no byte loss, since a 99.83 row already contributes 0 matched_code, but a strict accuracy regression).

proposals.confidence: high that the bodies fold; IRREDUCIBLE as to which spelling the call site meant
evidence: Both bodies are 4 bytes, 0x4e800020 (a bare blr), with ZERO relocations.
The target spelling is DEFINED identically (same 4 bytes) in 18 of our compiled objs.

Identical bytes + no relocations is precisely the condition under which MSVC's /OPT:ICF folds, and precisely the 'relocation-free thunk' class GROUNDED-1 records as irreducible: the fold is provable but which name the call site meant was destroyed by ICF itself.
